text_block_list.text:
One winter day.
While walking through the shopping district with Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! For keeping you out this late
accompanying me on my personal shopping...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you so much...!
Thanks to you, I was able to buy the book I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, since I went bookstore hopping, I ended
up getting distracted by books other than the ones
I was looking for, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
There's... a crowd gathering over there.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-The lottery...!
Come to think of it, I did get a ticket
at the bookstore earlier.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A lottery... testing my luck, huh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You've already stayed this late for me as it is...
I'd feel awful asking for any more of your time...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But... well,
I kind of thought... maybe a true hero needs a bit of luck too...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah, are you sure it's okay...!?
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then... E-Excuse me!
One turn, please...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one raffle ticket!
Come on now, give it a good spin!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
H-Here I go!
Goddess of Destiny, bear witness to me...!

Zenno Rob Roy enthusiastically
turned the raffle wheel handle!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wait?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah-wa-wa... I thought 2nd prize would be amazing enough...
Grand prize!?"
choice_data_list: Luck is just another sign of a true hero! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you think so...? I sure hope so...
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, a hot spring trip, huh... Oh, right!
Trainer, do you happen to know any
legends about hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "You see, because Japan has many volcanoes, there are naturally countless 'ancient hot springs' that bubble up from the earth—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Just like historical buildings, such hot springs are often enriched with various anecdotes, legends, and myths!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For example, there are hot springs said to have been
discovered by great generals of the Heian period,
and famous waters where mythical gods are said to have bathed—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Ah. S-Sorry, I just got carried away...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway...! The hot springs we can visit with these travel vouchers might have similar legends behind them, so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So, um... err...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: W-Would you care to... join me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that is provided
things have settled down with the Twinkle Series, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? Yay...!
...It's a promise, okay!
Once a hero's tale reaches a milestone, a hot spring trip. An intermission like that isn't so bad.
To make this pleasant intermission truly shine, and to fully stretch my wings at the hot springs, I fired myself up to keep giving it my all from tomorrow on!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Whoa, first prize...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It seems Lady Luck
has smiled upon us...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
Well then, this "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak" is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-If it's alright with you... Trainer, I'd like you to have this...
choice_data_list: Was there something in there you don't like?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! 
It's not that, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really much of a gourmet, so...
I feel like getting the "Special Grade" would be a bit of a waste on me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-Since it's such high quality, I think the Salisbury steak would be happier being eaten by someone with a refined palate...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: H-Here you go...! If you don't mind, that is.

I actually got a
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"...!

That night.
I pondered in front of the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"
I had received.

We could just eat it as is, but
Zenno Rob Roy is the one who won it, after all—

"I really do want her to eat it...!
I decided to arrange it into a bento and bring it to the academy tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Having lunch on the rooftop... somehow feels so... youthfully cinematic...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why the rooftop...?
I mean, having lunch with you is, um, really nice, but..."
choice_data_list: I made a boxed lunch for us.
I made a bento for you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, you did, Trainer...!?
Handmade...!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you sure I can eat this?
It feels... almost like a waste to eat something so nice...!"
choice_data_list: Because I wanted you to eat it...
Because I wanted you to eat it...

text_block_list.text:
"Even though all I did was heat up a pre-packaged hamburger steak and pack it..."
I open the bento box and hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is this yesterday's
"Premium Carrot Hamburg Steak"...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Well then... bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Munch, munch...)
...Mmh?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's delicious.
It really is way better than a normal carrot hamburg steak...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's strange... I never used to give any thought to the value of luxury items...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Why is this so delicious...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (…Could it be…)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Is it... because I'm eating together with Trainer...?)

I spent the lunch break eating bento with Zenno Rob Roy.
It seems she really enjoyed it...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
Second prize is still plenty lucky, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy...! But this is an incredible amount...!
What should I do? Maybe I should share some with you, Trainer...?
When I replied that Zenno Rob Roy had gone out of her way to win it for her, she fell into deep thought.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I could hand them out at the dorm,
or give some to my roommate... and then...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right...!

Zenno Rob Roy looked as though she had thought of something.
After the two of us carried the prize carrots back to the dorm,
we called it a day.
The next day—the table in the Trainer's office was packed wall-to-wall with carrot-based sweets!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you see...
These are all sweets that appear
in my favorite stories...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I remembered there was a recipe book in the library compiling ways to recreate fictional sweets like that, you see...
choice_data_list: Amazing! You made this so well.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...
Though, of course it wasn't just on my own—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: My roommate Rice-san is great at cooking, so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A little—no, a lot, or rather, immensely...
They helped me out so much...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-So... I can guarantee it's delicious...!
Please go ahead and try some...!

After putting my hands together in thanks,
I pick out the most misshapen piece.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's...!

"Because that is likely what
Zenno Rob Roy created."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wh-What do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...!
...Thank goodness...!
That day was spent enjoying delicious sweets with Zenno Rob Roy and the other Umamusume who visited the Trainer's Office!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It looks delicious, but hmm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's not it...!
I just don't usually do much cooking, so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how best to eat it.
I couldn't really think of any recipes...

Zenno Rob Roy and I stared at the carrots in our hands and pondered for a bit.
Miso soup, whole-roasted... there are plenty of options, but—
choice_data_list: ...Why not just nibble on it on the way home?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
E-Eating on the go...!?
And raw whole carrots, at that...!?
That's just—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That actually sounds a bit outlaw-like!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you for the food...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good...!
Hehe, sometimes you just want to do something a little naughty like this, you know...?

Zenno Rob Roy headed home while munching on a carrot.
Her steps were noticeably more confident than usual—
...Or so it felt.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Au...
Ah, no, thank you very much...
choice_data_list: That was a bit of a shame.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes... b-but you see!
There are figures who are regarded as heroes
despite their misfortune...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For example,
the hero who slew the evil dragon in Germanic mythology
became immortal after bathing in dragon's blood, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Back then, by sheer bad luck,
a leaf had stuck to his back,
so that was the only spot that didn't become invincible.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In the end, his weakness was exploited, costing him his life—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it,
that's a bit of bad luck...

Zenno Rob Roy ended up feeling
a little down in the dumps...
